notes:
Round-3 fixes, one per finding.

MEDIUM — AdminAr.Organisation.Cycle.Example (src/Wakeel.Admin.UI/Text/AdminAr.Organisation.cs). The old body folded day 1 onto 28 and always printed month 4, so the default state read «… تبدأ دورة شهر ٣ في ١/٣ وتنتهي في ٢٨/٤.», contradicting the rule printed directly above it and stretching the example over almost two months. It is now two branches: day <= 1 returns «مع اليوم ١: تبدأ دورة شهر ٣ في ١/٣ وتنتهي في ٣١/٣.» (the cycle ends on the last day of the same month; March is used so the example never has to talk about February), day >= 2 keeps «{day}/٣ … {day-1}/٤». New fact TheCycleExample_EndsTheCycleOnTheDayBeforeItStarts_IncludingTheDefaultDay reads Example(1)/Example(2)/Example(28) and pins the end day AND month of each (the day-1 assertion also asserts «/٤» is absent), so the branch cannot drift back. Confirmed live on the host: default day prints «٣١/٣», day ٢ prints «١/٤».

LOW — A03 device wording (src/Wakeel.Admin.UI/Services/AdminDashboardService.cs, AdminAr.Common.cs, AdminAr.Dashboard.cs, A03Dashboard.razor). Took the stronger of the two offered fixes. AdminDashboard gained ActivatedDevices, read from the tables under the same live-branch rule (FromLiveDevices + v.revoked_at IS NULL + EXISTS accounts.status='active'), plus RegisteredDevices and DevicesWaitingActivation; the ambiguous derived ActiveDevices is gone. Counting.ActiveDevices became Counting.ActivatedDevices («جهاز مفعّل / جهازان مفعّلان / ٣ أجهزة مفعّلة / ١١ جهازًا مفعّلًا») so the «نشط» wording cannot come back, and Dashboard.DevicesRevoked became Dashboard.DevicesStatus(activated, waiting, revoked), which prints only the parts that exist. New fact registers three devices, activates one, revokes one and asserts 3/1/1/1/2 on the board plus the exact line. Live on the host with that same state: A07 shows «مفعّل», «بانتظار التفعيل», «مُلغى» and A03 now reads «٣ أجهزة» over «جهاز مفعّل · جهاز بانتظار التفعيل · جهاز مُلغى» — the same vocabulary.
